facts: Named by Pitchfork's Kieran Press-Reynolds in "A Deeply Incomplete Canon of Hyperpop-Digicore" - an independent digicore/hyperpop internet artist.
Released the collab tape 'Persona' with mayh3mp on Cult Love Sound Tapes (2022): 5 tracks, limited cassette run of 100.
The two Aster Da Master tracks carrying a capoxxo title credit are 'candy' (2019-10-04, prod. razorwrist) and 'getting colder' (2019-12-22, prod. pvscale x asa41).

Streaming-metrics layer (musicmetricsvault, data ~2 months old, single-source): 53,275 monthly listeners, 29,890 followers, 36.6M total streams, 119 releases. Most-streamed: 'Perfect' (Apr 18, 2020, 6.2M streams), 'Ouueeoueou' (Mar 19, 2019, 2.6M), 'wait 4 it' (Aug 7, 2020, 2.3M), 'Monster' (Mar 19, 2020, 2.2M), 'IDLY' (Dec 29, 2023, 2.1M). Related artists: dreamcache, 5v, Pitfall, Senses, mayh3mp, Hinoni, RudeClub, bliiiss, Boofbby, Peake, mental, bodyGaard, Kid Trash, tropes, dxsh, emorave archive, Dion, kid sora, Crystal Statues.
'dont sleep (feat. bliiiss)' - released by Hinoni, 22 Oct 2023; explicit feature credit on the primary-artist Qobuz page (single-source, direct open).

'Perfect' trio: last.fm's track page lists 'Perfect Capoxxo, Oaf1 & Dreamcache' (index snapshot, crawl ~10 days) and musicmetricsvault prints 'Perfect (feat. Oaf1 & Dreamcache)' - two single-sources, two rounds, never presented as confirmed press.

First verifiable live appearances: Oct 28 Seattle @ Arch Rivals Studios (116 S Washington St), doors 7:30 PM, $25.63; Oct 29 Portland @ 211 SE Madison St, doors 7 PM, $28.52 - a Korpsebunny support bill with mayh3mp and Scarly (Portland also Eunhae + DJ sets from B3xtac33, DJ Shortstop, Sora Boyd) (Eventbrite listings, direct open, single-source each). Songkick still reads 'Off tour' - headliner data; mainstream trackers don't list the support slots.

Qobuz catalog: 46 albums; newest single 'nostalgia' (30 Jun 2026, Hinoni) (direct open). 'Sorry' - releasing entity printed as 'Teo Laza & Capoxxo' (9 May 2023, single-source); association-level, never published as a confirmed collab.

last.fm index snapshots (direct pages blocked 11 rounds running): top tracks 'perfect' (394 listeners), 'ouueeoueou' (148), 'it was beautiful' (133), 'sequence' (94), 'monster' (90) - crawl ~5 days; similar artists oaf1 and 'Capoxxo, mayh3mp' (368 listeners); 'Wett Brain, Capoxxo' page tracks 'Fxcked Up Bad' (59), 'IDLY' (55) (single-source, index snapshots).
mayh3mp - recent activity: '# madeira funchal' (4 Sep 2026) and '# i kno u' on Last.fm's recently-popular view (single-source).

'Lullaby' distributor evidence: a scraped nhaccuatui page lists 'Lullaby (Single), phonewifey, mayh3mp, Capoxxo' and states 'Uploaded by The Orchard' (single-source); the DMY smart link dmy.ffm.to/lullaby (single-source); Trackify streaming metadata (159.9 BPM, key B, single-source). No exact release date on record.

'Torn Ft Capoxxo & Lil Yu Prod Truss' appears on mayh3mp's 'mylifeasahorse' cassette (Cult Love Sound Tapes, ~2022-era catalog, single-source) - a capoxxo x lil yu x mayh3mp scene link new to the graph.

facts: Raps as Lil Wintr under his birth name Christian Baello; a rapper from Lake Elsinore, California (The FADER, 2019-06-04).
Produces under the alias Ginseng — the same alias carrying the archive's 'master key' production credit (The FADER).
Guitarist and percussionist in the band dream, ivory, alongside his brother Louie Baello (Peso Talk) (The FADER).
Member of the D1 SoundCloud supergroup with Despair, Shiro, Marcelo, and Hella Sketchy (The FADER; NTS).

Both archive tracks carry Marcelo alongside: 'Master Key (feat. Lil Wintr & Marcelo)' and 'master key ft. Lil Wintr x Marcelo (prod. ginseng)' (2019-12-06) — the second produced under his own producer alias (archive cross-reference).

Also produces for capoxxo ('angels watch me'; 'Summer Days [prod. pvscale]' for spiff x capoxxo), lil koi, lil yu ('i miss you (feat. pvscale)'), and kevinhilfiger/kidtrashpop ('buy It !') - per public tracklistings.

facts: Friend and collaborator of Lil Peep ('Gus'); co-produced Lil Peep x Lil Tracy's 'Witchblades' with BigHead — the credit is carried on the GothBoiClique SoundCloud (Underground Underdogs interview, 2018-02-23).
Makes his own vocal music ('fast car (faster)') alongside albums of instrumentals (same interview).
Both produces and features on his archive track: 'All Alone ft. Yung Cortex (prod. Yung Cortex)' (2019-12-30) (archive cross-reference).
The 'Witchblades' credit sits in the GothBoiClique orbit — the same collective scene figure Fish Narc belongs to (archive cross-reference).
